summary.text: Biochemistry is the study of chemical processes within and relating to living organisms.
It is a sub-discipline of both chemistry and biology and may be divided into structural biology, enzymology, and metabolism.
Its findings are applied mainly in medicine, nutrition, and agriculture, and combined with engineering methods it gives biotechnology.

facts.label: CHNOPS
facts.value: Six elements make up over 99% of the mass of our cells

facts.label: An early landmark
facts.value: Diastase, discovered in 1833 by Anselme Payen

facts.label: Urea synthesis
facts.value: Wöhler's 1828 urea synthesis, seen by some as overthrowing vitalism

items.prompt: A biochemist studies how cells harness energy from their surroundings through chemical reactions. Which field is that?
items.explain: The mechanisms cells use to harness energy from their environment via chemical reactions are known as metabolism.

items.prompt: Nearly all the biomolecules in a cell are built from six bulk elements. Which set is it?

options.label: Calcium, sodium, potassium, magnesium, iron, zinc
Carbon, silicon, boron, bromine, iodine, selenium
Carbon, hydrogen, nitrogen, oxygen, phosphorus, sulfur
Hydrogen, helium, lithium, carbon, nitrogen, oxygen

items.explain: Biomolecules are built from CHNOPS: carbon, hydrogen, nitrogen, oxygen, phosphorus, and sulfur.

items.prompt: Someone believes only living beings can make the molecules of life. A chemist then makes urea from potassium cyanate and ammonium sulfate. What belief did some see this as overthrowing?

options.label: Vitalism, a special vital principle in living matter
Atomism, the idea that matter is made of particles
Fermentation theory, the idea that yeast makes alcohol
Cell theory, the idea that all life is made of cells

items.explain: Some regarded Wöhler's synthesis as a direct overthrow of vitalism, the belief in a vital principle only living things have.

items.prompt: A biochemist studies soil and fertilizers to improve crop storage and pest control. Which application area is that?
items.explain: In agriculture, biochemists investigate soil and fertilizers to improve crop cultivation, storage, and pest control.

items.prompt: A farmer notes that all animals require sodium and asks if every crop plant must have it too. What does the biochemistry say?

options.label: It is essential for only a small subset of plants
No plant is helped by it
Plants need sodium but animals do not

items.explain: Sodium is essential for only a small subset of plants, although many others grow better in its presence.

items.prompt: Biochemical methods are combined with engineering problem-solving to manipulate living systems and make tools for research, industry and diagnosing disease. What is that discipline called?
items.explain: Combining biochemical principles with engineering approaches to manipulate living systems is the discipline of biotechnology.
